description: An emulation of the four rate, four level envelope of a DX7 operator, with two VCAs for stereo audio built in. It runs polyphonically, one voice for each channel arriving at the gate input

params.text: How fast the envelope moves to LEVEL 1; the range runs from very slow to very fast, and the setting reads 0 to 1 in the manner of a DX7
How fast the envelope moves from LEVEL 1 to LEVEL 2
How fast the envelope moves from LEVEL 2 to LEVEL 3
How fast the envelope moves from LEVEL 3 to LEVEL 4
The level the envelope rises to first, from zero to full
The level the envelope moves to after LEVEL 1
The level the envelope holds at while a gate stays high
The level the envelope ends on after the gate drops
Scales the height of the envelope, -1 to 1; a negative setting inverts the shape
Adds a fixed voltage to the envelope, -10V to +10V
A tap fires the envelope by hand

inputs.text: A gate or trigger starts the envelope, and a lamp shows while it is high; a gate holds the envelope at LEVEL 3 until it drops, while a trigger runs the whole shape through
Audio into one of the two VCAs whose level the envelope sets; each takes sixteen polyphonic channels

outputs.text: The audio of that VCA, at the level the envelope sets
Passes the incoming gate or trigger straight out, so several of these envelopes can be run from one signal
The envelope voltage with its sign flipped
